axis: A test file counts as EXECUTED iff its repo-relative path appears as a literal token in a pytest argv that an EXECUTING runner passes to a pytest process.  The executing runners are: (R1) a CI job's `run:` block in .github/workflows/ci.yml; (R2) a pre-flight gate registered in the `all` or `launch` pipeline of molmetal/scripts/pre_flight_check.py. A path quoted in a COMMENT, a DOCSTRING, a YAML `name:` field or a shell variable is a MENTION and does NOT count.  The Makefile's `test:` target names the whole molmetal/tests DIRECTORY and would cover the whole population, but NO CI job and NO runner calls `make test`, so it is NOT an executing runner and is excluded.
honest_limits: This baseline is the blind spot made EXPLICIT, not an adjudication of 1337 individual defects: every entry carries the uniform reason 'NOT_ON_ANY_EXECUTING_RUNNER_ARGV'.
The Makefile's `test:` target names the whole molmetal/tests DIRECTORY and would cover the entire population, but NO CI job and NO runner calls `make test`, so it is NOT an executing runner.
The `frontier` and `cfm` pre-flight pipelines are never selected by an automated runner, so their pytest gates are excluded by construction.
